lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You ate that whole pizza the other night, and you sure you don't want another sandwich? (Brendan shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: It's gonna be just a bit, OK?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Am I gonna be at school before school ends?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Probably not. I mean we're at two thirty already, and schools over at what, three? (Brendan nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: What time will this be done?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Well, we're pretty, we're pretty much done. We have a couple follow up things ta ask ya, but its pretty much done.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: ......considering er what we had mentioned earlier we would like ta maybe go out ta the property so you can point out some of these things and where some of this stuff was.
